verdict.rationale: Prompt navigation through shell integration is a fair question for a terminal emulator, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions shell integration, prompt marks, or a jump-to-prompt action. Related items such as bindable actions, scrollback size and password-prompt detection for secure keyboard entry are adjacent features and do not show prompt or command-mark navigation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can jump between prompts and command marks in my scrollback thanks to shell integration
